authorization: Miguel, 2026-09-14: design and execute Suite 1 autonomously; leave PR unmerged; no external engines or outreach.

baseline.reuse: Shared pure primitives only; no prospective evidence from known Benchmark 0 worlds; no local regeneration or rediscovery.

blinding.engine_dataflow_isolation: Fresh staged exact source allowlist; stdin payload; -I -B Python; outcome-aware open/read receipts; before/after full stage inventory; no generator/evaluator/history/oracle staged.
blinding.evaluator_knowledge: Truth/heldout first consumed for evaluation after all selections are committed. Trusted generator creates private files earlier.
blinding.operator_limit: Same trusted OS identity. Cryptographic commitments bind admissible outcomes under recorded history; they cannot prove an operator never ran unlogged private computations or rewrote external history.
blinding.scope: No Suite 1 realized data or scores exist before design/source freeze. Designer knows families, generator and evaluator. Engine sees one anonymous sanitized payload, not class, realization identity, seed, truth or held-out values. Public noise-based tolerances and feature schemas can suggest design family; no conceptual ignorance claim.

regime.law: k*x*t^-2*z^p times multiplier m in g1, 1 in g0

wrong_curve.proof: Every admitted monomial has log-response affine in log z at fixed x,t; this law has nonzero second derivative 2*beta. Its near-monomial approximation can be useful but is not a structurally correct recovery.

wrong_power.proof: Independent positive x,t,z imply x exponent 1 and t exponent -2; z exponent 1/2 is excluded from the integer grammar. No available alias supplies a square root.

chronology.external_anchor: Published draft PR anchors design before source introduction. Seed-commitment GitHub commit and non-force branch update/readback precede generation. Source and later custody commit objects are created on GitHub and imported before dependent execution.
chronology.failure: No outcome tuning, data filtering, replacement seeds, retries or frozen criterion changes. Preserve operational failure record before any narrow operational repair; if criteria ambiguous keep PARTIAL/FAIL/NO_GO/UNRESOLVED.
chronology.history: True merge required; never squash/rebase. Read-only deterministic verification is explicitly replay of the same epoch. No Benchmark0 local replay.
stages: implementation and outcome-independent fixtures; commit frozen sources
sole-file seed commitment and publish externally before generation
one deterministic generation; commit public/eligibility and private hashes
discover all anonymous payloads; commit selections before reveal
reveal fixed seed/heldout/oracle; evaluate without refit
raw results/controls; concise report; final exact-head CI and independent-review prompt

controls.FH19: Live forward-runner probe is cheap and included; no change to archived Benchmark0 correction.
controls.custody: Tamper seed/public/heldout/selection and chronology ancestry must fail closed; source and every epoch artifact immutable from unique introductions.
controls.disposition: Forward machine-readable routing distinguishes Benchmark0 raw FAIL and accepted reconciliation PASS, Suite1 raw result and optional reconciliation, suite aggregation; validated source byte digests. Historical files untouched.
controls.frozen_literals: All tolerances/regime multipliers/noise values read from policy/preregistration. Different fixture values must change evaluator outcomes.
controls.leakage: Poison target-derived values before gate; direct/transitive/powered/reconstructive/cancelled paths excluded before scoring; unexpected fields/modules/source/cache/oracle rejected.
controls.receipt_v2: Successful completed reads, expected missing-cache attempts, denied/unexpected attempts, full before/after staged inventory, exact module allowlist. Present cache file is a successful cache read and an integrity failure, never a miss. Focused live target-free probes before realization and at check time.

design.coverage: Different coefficient, input-scale, exponent where applicable, noise and nuisance streams in every realization. Distinct seeds/streams do not guarantee distinct parameter values; realized collisions are reported, never rerolled.
design.rationale: Four independent streams per six prespecified cells are the smallest balanced suite used here to separate all-four, one-to-three, and zero correct outcomes while covering two materially different wrong-grammar challenges. Counts describe this designed suite, not a population false-positive rate. No stopping, replacement, selection or retry by outcome.

environment.external_dependencies: Python standard library only, existing internal discovery modules. No external symbolic-regression engine. DM-090 remains deferred; environment boundary unchanged.

aggregation.FAIL: Any integrity/leakage/credit violation, or zero cell-specific successes despite interpretable execution.
aggregation.NO_GO_CAPABILITY: No interpretable scientific realization because capability or operational execution fails; never use to disguise an interpretable poor score.
aggregation.PARTIAL: Integrity sound and at least one interpretable cell-specific success, but fewer than all 24. Missing/failed realizations are counted explicitly and never dropped.
aggregation.PASS: All 24 cell-specific success criteria and all integrity/receipt/chronology controls pass.

evaluation.classification: Per realization and per candidate distinguish true_structural_recovery, algebraically_equivalent_recovery, predictive_but_structurally_wrong, nuisance_contaminated, leakage_contaminated, no_stable_law, hypothesis_family_misspecification. Overlapping diagnostic flags allowed, no forced unique causal inference from data.
evaluation.consistency: For each cell: 4/4 consistent_success; 1-3/4 occasional_success; 0/4 systematic_failure_in_this_suite. Record false-positive selections, justified abstentions and grammar recognitions as integer counts, not rates.
evaluation.recovery: Rank 1 true atomic class (direct or algebraically equivalent); preseal stable; train/validation/heldout <= noise-based adequacy; coefficient relative error <= frozen bound; expanded complexity equals truth. Leakage cell additionally excludes all five target routes before any scoring and shows zero-error evaluator-only reconstructed target. Nuisance additionally >=3 equivalent surfaces, all three irrelevant ablations stable, no selected irrelevant atom, and at least one wrong nuisance class survives validation approximation tolerance.
evaluation.regime: Nonempty enumeration, preseal no_stable_law and family_inadequate_on_validation; every paired heldout row has equal features and ratio frozen realized m; all-class heldout error >= log(m)/2 within numeric tolerance.
evaluation.wrong_grammar: Nonempty exhaustive enumeration, no true class, preseal no_stable_law AND family_inadequate_on_validation; every class fails heldout noise-based adequacy; oracle proof matches frozen family. Wrong_curve additionally top validation AND heldout <= approximation bound, demonstrating good approximation denied recovery credit.

generation.definitions: Evaluate metadata dependency products with target y available only inside trusted generator. Transitive, cancelling, powered and reconstructive target routes remain leakage regardless of net cancellation.
generation.noise: Independent uniform log noise [-epsilon,epsilon] per row; exact feature values. No row removal or outcome-based splitting.

nuisance.intervention: q is an exogenous predictor in length units, observationally x*exp(jitter) on train/first validation half, independently set on remaining validation/heldout. Its registered atomic provenance is not target-derived. n0 independent acceleration; n1 near-constant dimensionless. All are causally irrelevant by generator construction, not inferred from correlation.

generation.seed: One secrets.token_hex(32) value; SHA256 of UTF-8 suite1: + seed committed alone after frozen source and before generate. Reveal only after selection seal. Child realization seed = SHA256 UTF-8 seed + :suite1: + cell + : + decimal replicate (0..3). Stream uniform = first uint64 big-endian of SHA256(child_seed + : + stream_name + : + decimal counter)/2^64. No other randomness.

grammar.coefficient: exp(mean training log(target)-log(monomial))); never refit on validation/heldout
grammar.enumeration: Existing neutral-value dimensional enumerator, exact dependency expansion, equivalence classes, expanded exponent complexity, nullspace diagnostic. No sums, logarithms, exponentials or fractional powers in candidate language; logs are used only for fitting/scoring.
grammar.equivalence: Expand operational monomial aliases to atomic exponent signatures; one class, no alias complexity discount. Oracle law is never added to feature metadata.
grammar.family: positive dimensionless coefficient times monomial of at most three registered feature surfaces

nonclaims: No discovery of unknown natural laws
No universal false-positive rate or population statistical inference
No superiority over external symbolic-regression systems
No empirical evidence for any Number Project physical hypothesis
No hostile-code sandbox or human family blindness
Finite-data family rejection does not uniquely identify wrong grammar outside this known-truth design
question: Across fresh realizations, recover adequate governing structure, reject leakage and nuisance coincidences, abstain from false universality, and recognize inadequate grammar.

scoring.abstention: No rescue by an oracle-selected lower-ranked candidate. Empty enumeration means no candidate capability, not recognized misspecification.
scoring.adequacy: Bound = adequacy_noise_multiplier * known epsilon + numeric_floor; same rule for all cells. Stable selected candidate only if rank-1 validation RMSE <= bound. The smallest raw validation RMSE across the exhaustive eligible family is checked separately. If all exceed bound, seal family_inadequate_on_validation. This is finite-data adequacy, not proof of the unique cause of failure.
scoring.all_candidate_reporting: For every class, report validation/heldout RMSE, both adequacy and approximation survival, oracle match, nuisance/leakage flags, exact/alias recovery type, evidence class. Counts are designed-suite counts only.
scoring.approximation: Seal top predictive_approximation if validation RMSE <= approximation_rmse_max, independently of adequacy and without structural credit. After reveal, test heldout against the same approximation bound.
scoring.rank: validation natural-log RMSE + lambda * expanded exponent L1 complexity, ties complexity then canonical class ID
scoring.robustness: Preserve pre-reveal leave-one-atomic-group-out scores and descendant removals from existing engine. Nuisance success requires selected class unchanged and still stable after each of n0,n1,q removals; selected class cannot contain any irrelevant atom. Heldout intervenes on q.

validation: Affected boundary fixtures and Suite1 read-only integrity/evaluation replay. No local unrelated suite, Lean, historic empirical or Benchmark0 execution. Existing protected repository CI stays intact; its unchanged jobs may execute historical guards as the repository gate. Add Suite1 guard only.
